record.paper_title: Problems and Conjectures in Matrix and Operator Inequalities
record.original_question: Let A and B be positive definite matrices normalized by Tr(A+B)=1. Does there exist a dimension-independent constant c such that the trace norm of the commutator [B, log(A+B)] is bounded by c times the binary entropy term -Tr A log Tr A - Tr B log Tr B? The source reports numerical evidence that the optimal constant may be c=1.

evidence.quote:
Conjecture 4 Let A, B be positive definite matrices such that Tr(A + B) = 1;
then there is a constant c (independent of the dimensions of A and B) such that
|| [B, log(A + B)] ||1 ≤ c(− Tr A log Tr A − Tr B log Tr B). (26)
Numerical work indicates that c might actually be 1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A$ and $B$ be positive definite matrices of the same finite size, normalized so that $\operatorname{Tr}(A+B)=1$. Let $\|\cdot\|_1$ denote the trace norm (Schatten 1-norm), and let $[X,Y]=XY-YX$ denote the commutator. Determine whether there exists a constant $c>0$, independent of the matrix dimension, such that
$$\bigl\|\,[B,\ \log(A+B)]\,\bigr\|_1 \;\le\; c\bigl(-\operatorname{Tr}(A)\log\operatorname{Tr}(A) - \operatorname{Tr}(B)\log\operatorname{Tr}(B)\bigr)$$
holds for all such pairs $(A,B)$. In particular, decide whether the choice $c=1$ suffices.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface any published proof, refutation, or progress specifically addressing this trace-norm commutator bound by the binary entropy term. Related work by Bhatia on partial traces and entropy inequalities exists, but no source directly resolves whether a dimension-independent constant (or specifically c=1) works in this inequality. The status therefore appears unresolved based on available evidence.

status_evidence.title: Partial traces and entropy inequalities
status_evidence.snippet: Bhatia's paper on partial traces and entropy inequalities; related context but does not establish the conjectured commutator-entropy bound.
status_evidence.claim: No direct resolution of the commutator-entropy conjecture is found in the related literature surfaced by search.

status_evidence.title: Matrix and Operator Trace Inequalities - Scholarpedia
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of matrix/operator trace inequalities; the specific conjectured bound is not listed as resolved.
status_evidence.claim: Standard references on matrix trace inequalities do not report a proof or counterexample.
